description: BFVZ PowerGantt brings project-controls-grade schedule analysis into Power BI: a Gantt chart visual with a full critical path engine, unlimited WBS hierarchy, baseline variance tracking, cross-project resource conflict detection, and 13 automated schedule quality checks aligned with the DCMA 14-Point Assessment and the GAO Schedule Assessment Guide. Everything runs inside the visual — no external services, and no data leaves your tenant. WHO IT IS FOR Project controls professionals, PMO analysts, schedulers, program managers, and construction managers who report CPM-driven schedules in Power BI. Shaped by work on energy, utilities, telecom, pipeline, water, and data center construction programs — and built for any industry that uses predecessor-linked scheduling. KEY BENEFITS • Trust the critical path — full CPM forward and backward pass with all four dependency types (FS, SS, FF, SF) and lag, flowing continuously through collapsed WBS groups and across every project in the program. • Catch schedule data problems before they reach leadership — missing logic, circular dependencies, invalid dates, broken references, high float, and long lags are flagged on every refresh with a severity-coded header indicator and a one-click validation report. • See slippage at a glance — baseline variance ribbons (green ahead, red behind) with configurable warning thresholds and full diagnostic…
